## Profile

I am a climate and energy policy researcher interested in how societies can reach net-zero emissions fairly and feasibly. My work uses integrated assessment modeling and scenario analysis to connect long-term climate goals with near-term policy choices.

I am particularly interested in carbon pricing, climate finance, carbon capture and storage (CCS), carbon dioxide removal (CDR), and the design of decarbonization pathways for Japan and the wider world.

## Research approach

My research combines quantitative models, policy analysis, and clear communication of uncertainty. I aim to produce work that is technically rigorous, transparent, and useful to decision-makers.
